name: Worldwide USD
oneLiner: WUSD is WSPN's centralized dollar stablecoin backed under its cash and Treasury reserve policy; advertised corporate redemption is currently unverified.
collateral: Cash, cash equivalents, and short-term U.S. Treasury bills under WSPN's reserve policy; the whitepaper describes a 6% buffer on non-cash reserves as a long-term goal, not a verified current balance
pegMechanism: WSPN documents direct 1:1 conversion for verified corporate customers, with minting and burning following fiat deposits and withdrawals; current redemption availability is unverified after the advertised mainnet portal failed DNS on October 19, 2026. No dated reserve-liability report was located in the reviewed public disclosures

notices.title: Severely limited trading; redemption unverified
notices.message: Following its completed December 2024 contract migration, WUSD lost reviewed centralized venues during July/August 2026. Coins.ph ended convert-sell on August 4 while allowing withdrawals; that venue's discontinuation is not a WSPN global-termination notice. DefiLlama supply contracted about 94%, from 9,986,097 on July 21 to 599,283.65 on October 19. The October 19 bounded exact-contract ETH/Polygon/Viction pool scan found no pool meeting the $50K liquidity admission floor, and CoinGecko returned no tickers; this is not proof that no market exists anywhere. WSPN still advertises 1:1 corporate conversion for qualified, verified businesses, but current redemption is unverified: the documented mainnet host wallet.wspn.io returned NXDOMAIN, and no production quote or bank settlement was observed. On Viction, historical on-chain evidence at block 112793798 showed a flat 100 WUSD fee on token calls, including transfers and approve(); this fee was not reverified on October 19 and is not asserted for Ethereum or Polygon. https://issuer.viction.xyz/token/0xBA73E59F11597c1c13B0D9114688Efb6A6D430F6
